simulation_notice: All series, dispatch trajectories and fault cases are simulations with uncalibrated PLACEHOLDER parameters; not device or site observations.

fault.fourth_stage: chemical preference follows equality freezing of all three actually achieved service values; configured earlier-stage tolerance rows remain in place.
fault.optimality_scope: Critical first stage requests gap0 and requires proof. Stage2/3 attained values are not falsely described as global optimality proofs.
fault.parallel_false: Both chemistries may supply within one hour, with the last-priority chemistry discharge minimized at stage4.
fault.parallel_true: Exact MILP bounded proportional allocation p_x=min(power_cap_x*lambda,positive_SOC_energy_limit_x). Power caps are fixed temperature-dependent coefficients; energy saturation permits the other chemistry to supplement.
fault.diagnostic_tolerance_example: fault_tolerance_results.json is explicitly a diagnostic reconstruction; production fourth-stage service equalities prevent that trade.

s_base.objective_and_mip_gap: NaN (null in JSON), not an optimality claim
s_base.task_rule: Stable arrival-order FCFS, earliest GPU-feasible contiguous execution
s_base.thermal_rule: Full dual-sided feasible heat-pump output, municipal priority, boiler supplements gap
s_base.power_rule: Renewable self-use first, then grid to its cap, then storage for the remaining forced shortfall
s_base.terminal_rule: Exact battery-side withdrawals d/eta_dis matched with eta_ch*c. Fixed-efficiency audit reduces to D_forced/(eta_ch*eta_dis); variable efficiencies are accounted slot by slot.
s_base.charge_selection: Available renewable surplus before grid supply; grid slots by lowest purchase price then ascending hour, all subject to power, band, mutual-exclusion, grid headroom and exact total energy quota.
s_base.inspection: Every complete rule vector is independently checked against the shared model rows, bounds and integer requirements. No MILP is used for baseline generation or verification.
s_base.failure_scope: Failure returns no valid normal trajectory and records its reason; a rule failure is not represented as a solver proof of global physical infeasibility.
s_base.soc_cap_curtailment_scope: Marginal additional feasible charging at actual hourly SOC when only the strategy quota is removed; retains physical limits and is not a full counterfactual trajectory. A0/P0 attribution is0.
